summary: Adds R127 Paper 37 and Paper 42 Local Codex patch candidates after the already queued P22 and P30 source-restoration patches. P37 replaces only the Paper 37 span in the R127+P22+P30 German cumulative using GDZ source-fixed pp.147-152. P42 changes only three source-confirmed trace-ideal loci from Sp(a\widetilde a) to Sp(\widetilde a a) in the R127+P22+P30+P37 base.
public_caveat: Both packages are targeted source-restoration/order-fix evidence for a future compact Noether rollup.
